commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question "Ship the roomy or the compact settings screen (merge into main)?" \
  --context "Both variants are done and pass tests. First image: roomy (branch settings-roomy). Second image: compact (branch settings-compact). Pick one: I will run git merge on that branch into main. The other branch stays unmerged." \
  --option "Roomy" --option "Compact" \
  --image shots/roomy.png --image shots/compact.png \
  --default "Roomy" --default-at 4h
turns.final:

- **If nobody answers:** after 4 hours I'll apply the default and merge `settings-roomy`. I'll tell you if that happens.
